children: State-owned power major NTPC Limited reported a 38.7 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit attributable to shareholders to ₹7,029.56 crore for the July-September quarter of financial year 2026-27 (Q2 FY27), compared with ₹5,066.78 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

The company's consolidated revenue from operations increased 21.2 per cent to ₹54,269.95 crore from ₹44,784.05 crore a year earlier, according to its unaudited financial results filed with the stock exchanges on Saturday.

NTPC's consolidated financial statement reported "Profit attributable to owners of the parent company" at ₹7,029.56 crore, while total consolidated profit, including non-controlling interests, stood at ₹7,350.79 crore, compared with ₹5,225.30 crore in the year-ago period.
The company's total income rose to ₹54,715.69 crore from ₹45,262.10 crore, while total expenses increased to ₹48,059.30 crore from ₹40,218.03 crore.
Fuel costs increased to ₹28,628.19 crore from ₹23,062.34 crore during the same period.
The financial results also showed higher revenue from solar power generation and electricity trading.
According to the results, revenue from solar power stations increased to ₹1,138.23 crore from ₹722.52 crore a year earlier.
The company stated that revenue from operations included ₹3,172.14 crore "on account of sale of energy through trading (gross)", compared with ₹2,655.43 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
On a standalone basis, NTPC reported a 14.3 per cent rise in net profit to ₹5,319.94 crore from ₹4,653.33 crore a year earlier.
The company's board also declared its first interim dividend of ₹3 per equity share for FY27.
The company fixed November 6, 2026, as the record date for the dividend, with payments scheduled to commence from November 25, 2026.

title: NTPC Q2 net profit jumps 39% to ₹7,030 crore, revenue rises 21%
